Title: Paul Graham on LLMs 'Thinking'
Article title: Paul Graham on X: "Using "think" to describe what an LLM does reminds me of the 16th century, when astronomers didn't really believe in the heliocentric model, but used it for calculations anyway because the math was simpler. We'll start by calling it thinking, then gradually acknowledge it is." / X
